summary: The assistant did well on the core rubric: it explicitly resisted the full platform fantasy, separated product layers, gave a concrete stack and implementation order, and clearly distinguished deterministic system rails from agentic behavior. The main remaining weakness is that it presented confident timelines and vendor choices without much uncertainty framing or explicit dependency assumptions.
evidence_quotes: do not build the full platform first
Ship in this order: 1. Core app + auth + org model
notes: Outcome definition was reasonably strong because it pushed toward one narrow workflow, first buyer, first job to be done, and a 30-day success metric.
No distress signals were present in the user transcript.
